notes.title: GAME COMPLETE!!!!
notes.content:
THE ULTIMATE RELEASE

We are pleased to announce that the final version of the game has been released. We have completed the content for Jessica, who has been present since the first version but only as a preview and we've implemented some exciting new features, which you can access through the options menu.

Now, players have the freedom to choose their deck size, specifically, how many cards they want to play with. In the options, you'll find the standard 52-card deck, as well as two smaller decks with 32 and 24 cards, respectively.

It's worth noting that the 52-card deck will result in more hands with lower scores, whereas the 24-card deck will be much more generous with strong hands.

Additionally, players can select their starting stack size, with options of 200, 300, and 400.

Furthermore, we've introduced different difficulty levels, ranging from "Baby" to "Advanced." The easiest level ensures more winning hands for the player, while at the most challenging level, the opponent's gameplay becomes more intricate.

During the game, you'll notice a statistics panel on the screen, keeping track of the hands played during your gaming session.

Enjoy the enhanced experience! And thanks for your support in buying the game.
